I went through all six of Moss's notes in the shared files and found **two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines**:

1. **#PD-4492** is from *"Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth"* (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched the SMS gateway routing at 19:30 that day, and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct shift got through with no manual work. A follow-up item asked for the Eau Claire kiosk logs to be archived before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419** is from *"Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)"* (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 during third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing. The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell when this one was opened.

**What I left out:**
- The 9/14 pipeline digest and the 3/23 renewal check-in both mention QFL, but neither gives a ticket number.
- Moss's two Central notes list tickets #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those are for Marrow accounts, not QFL.
- Marcus's competitive intel note is about *Quarendon Freightways*, a different company that isn't our customer. Moss's cheat sheet warns not to mix the two up.

I only checked Moss's notes in the shared files. I didn't search channel messages.
